behaviors.title: Sandwich / backrun of slippage-unprotected trades
behaviors.description: Searchers wrap a victim swap with a buy and a sell so the victim trades at a worse price.
behaviors.defense: minAmountOut, short deadline, private orderflow, or RFQ.

behaviors.title: Front-run of initialize / first deposit / commit
behaviors.description: Mempool observers take ownership of a proxy or poison a vault before the intended first user.
behaviors.defense: Atomic deploy+initialize, dead shares, commit-reveal bound to msg.sender.

behaviors.title: SELFDESTRUCT no longer clears code mid-transaction (Cancun)
behaviors.description: After EIP-6780, selfdestruct only sends value unless it is in the same transaction as creation. Emergency-destroy designs break.
behaviors.defense: Do not rely on selfdestruct as an upgrade or pause mechanism.

behaviors.title: Transient storage leaks within a transaction
behaviors.description: tstore lives for the whole transaction. A later call in the same tx can read leftover locks or allowances.
behaviors.defense: Clear transient slots before exiting; do not treat tstore as msg-local.

behaviors.title: Sequencer downtime freezes oracles and liquidations
behaviors.description: If the sequencer is down, timestamps stall and stale prices remain 'fresh' relative to block.timestamp.

behaviors.title: Account-abstraction paymaster / validation griefing
behaviors.description: Validation that reads mutable state or makes external calls can be griefed or drained by bundlers.
behaviors.defense: Keep validateUserOp pure wrt third-party state; bound paymaster gas.

behaviors.title: ETH can arrive without receive/fallback
behaviors.description: selfdestruct, block rewards, and some system contracts can increase balance without calling receive.
behaviors.defense: Track deposits in storage; never treat raw balance as an invariant.

behaviors.title: CREATE2 identity is not code identity
behaviors.description: The same address can hold different code across time if the original contract can be destroyed.
behaviors.defense: Pin extcodehash; avoid selfdestruct at CREATE2 addresses.

behaviors.title: Raw token transfer used as an accounting input
behaviors.description: Anyone can increase a contract's token balance without going through mint/deposit. If share price, health, or reserves read that balance, the donation is an attack primitive.
behaviors.defense: Ignore unexpected balance increases; run solvency checks on donate; use virtual offsets for shares.

behaviors.title: Permissionless registry becomes a callback oracle
behaviors.description: A public add-market/add-strategy function lets an attacker install a contract that later supplies harvest callbacks or prices.
behaviors.defense: Governance-gated listings with a delay; treat registered addresses as untrusted until allowlisted.

behaviors.title: Documented multisig is not a proof of key isolation
behaviors.description: Radiant 2024-class losses came from malware on signer devices meeting a live threshold. The Solidity was fine.
behaviors.defense: Hardware isolation, delayed execution, distinct custodians, and a pause that is not held by the same signers.
